semantics: All gap parameters n>=0, all nine primary values satisfying the named decrement guard, every finite nonempty spare suffix.
gap_effect: For returning instructions: positive decrement +1; overflow +1; all other cases +0. Halt has no target frame.
spare_effect: For returning instructions: increment appends [1]; other operations preserve suffix
scope: Finite exhaustive symbolic check using four proved mathematical register contracts; not a Lean or Rocq kernel check.
